release_read.basis: Revenue $33.0m vs ~$27.5m consensus (+20%), non-GAAP EPS $0.28 vs $0.11, bookings $46.7m (book-to-bill 1.4), FY27 guide raised to the top of the range ($150m vs $130-150m) with non-GAAP net income >=20%; the feared second-device slip did not worsen (still calendar 2027, customer forecasts higher volume than the first). Clean beat-and-raise on a name that halved in 20 days with ~17% of float short, sized at about the median past reaction (~22%) and above the 14.9% implied move, shaded for the call being unread.

release.headline: Aehr Test Systems Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results (record revenue $33.0m, bookings $46.7m, FY27 revenue outlook raised to $150m)
release.release_time_note: Released 2026-11-02 after the close, before the 17:00 ET call; exact minute not stated in the exhibit.

key_line.metric: FY27 guide and second hyperscaler device timing
key_line.detail: FY27 revenue raised to $150m (top of prior $130-150m); effective backlog $109.3m as of 2026-11-01; second AI processor qualified on Sonoma, production ramp still calendar 2027, customer forecasts higher volumes than the first device. The slip the panel feared did not widen.

guidance.detail: FY27 revenue $150m vs $130-150m prior; non-GAAP net income at least 20% of revenue (prior 18-22% non-GAAP pre-tax margin).

call.detail: Call held last night at 17:00 ET; no transcript read in the time available, so tone and Q&A (incl. the Teradyne question) are unverified. No call or company event left in today's session.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched: under the 09:24 deadline the tape and the release were prioritised. No analyst actions recorded.

tape_read.note: Robust reference $62.00 (+20.5% vs $51.47 prev close), last print 09:12 at $62.12, right at the pre-market high $62.16; after-hours was $58.67 (+14.0%), so the price climbed overnight and into the open. 141 prints, 25 in the last 30 minutes, not stale. +20.5% is above my +17% release read and well beyond the 14.9% implied move, in line with the ~22% median past reaction. Mildly overshot against the release read, in the position's favour; QQQ +0.7% helps a little.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a small long on positioning plus visible bookings against the second-device slip; the release delivered a large beat, a raise and no further slip.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (141 prints, 25 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:12) ending at its high, so the open should hold most of the +20.5%. A gap of this size, beyond the implied move and above my release read, on an amc print that has had a full night, usually gives some back in the first half hour; short covering (17% of float) is the main risk to that fade.

recommendation.reason: Sterke cijfers en een verhoogde jaarprognose, maar de koers staat voorbeurs al ruim 20% hoger, meer dan de cijfers volgens ons rechtvaardigen en meer dan de opties verwachtten. Bij een avondmelding zit het nieuws meestal al bij de opening in de koers en geeft de dag daarna vaak wat terug, dus verkoop bij de opening en neem de winst van circa 18% mee (de standaardregel).
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 nog duidelijk verder stijgt boven $63 met veel transacties en er meerdere koersdoelverhogingen van analisten binnenkomen, is een limietorder boven de voorbeurskoers te overwegen in plaats van verkopen bij de opening.
